correctness.rationale: Complete field-uniform proof: homogeneous quadratic fixed lines correspond to nonzero idempotents; irreducibility of cT^3-dT^2+aT-b implies determinant nonzero and conversely. Cubic Frobenius-orbit count yields N_q. Every natural basis is monomial for perfect algebras. Explicit diagonal and off-diagonal fixed-point equations and Burnside give both isomorphism counts and exact automorphism groups. Bundled exhaustive checks for ten finite fields, including direct idempotent testing through q=9, reproduce all arithmetic.

Its Section 4 does not give the special subset totals, so the proposed theorem is not an immediate stated corollary without the new irreducible-cubic filter.

value.rationale: The integer one-third law gives a field-independent, whole-space frequency for a natural finite-algebra structural property; the exact all-q isomorphism count and unique order-three symmetry stratum quantify moduli and distinguish q mod3. Existence alone and generic monomial classification do not answer this natural counting problem. Proof is complete with no unproved infinite extrapolation.
